headline: Bafna Pharmaceuticals files Reg. 31(4) disclosure for substantial acquisition
sum: Bafna Pharmaceuticals Limited has filed a SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure on NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition event. The specific acquirer, consideration and acquisition percentage remain unconfirmed from the primary public disclosure.
detail: Under SEBI (SAST) Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4) requires immediate disclosure of substantial acquisitions of shares and voting rights. Bafna Pharmaceuticals filed this disclosure at NSE on 30 June 2026. The filing itself is a regulatory gate: depending on the acquisition percentage, an open offer may be mandated under Regulation 4. Full transaction details (acquirer name, shares/percentage, consideration) must be verified from the full PDF filing or company investor-relations page.
